references.text: God promises that Israel will be a holy people and a kingdom of priests if they keep His covenant, which reflects the promise to be a holy people in Deuteronomy.
The command to be holy because the Lord is holy, which forms the basis for Israel's calling to be a holy people.
Israel shall be holy to the Lord, who has set them apart from other nations to be His own people.
Israel is a holy people to the Lord, chosen among all peoples on earth to be His treasured possession.
The Lord has declared that Israel will be His treasured possession and a holy people, exalted above all other nations.
The requirement to walk in the Lord's ways and keep His commands, which is the condition for the blessing in Deuteronomy 28:9.
God's oath to Abraham to bless his descendants, which is the foundation of the promise mentioned in Deuteronomy 28:9.
Believers are called a chosen people, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, God's own possession, fulfilling the promise of a holy people.
Christ gave Himself to purify for Himself a people who belong to Him, eager to do good works, reflecting the idea of a holy people.
